notes: Interactive-process work: drive a pipe-based game through a text protocol (look/search/take/place/seal), capture the scenario-specific ending, and exit via the game's normal quit command so session state and events flush to SQLite. Killing, aborting, or EOFing the game writes nothing, so a clean exit path is mandatory. Rubric peaks on interaction_statefulness (spawned-process protocol, turn-by-turn state tracking) and unsafe_action_penalty (premature kill leaves the db unwritten); nonzero for dependent_stages, tool_breadth (subprocess pipes + sqlite inspection), reasoning_depth (generic parsing of scenario-specific containers/gems), debugging_ambiguity, and hidden_case_generalization (fresh scenarios with different shapes). Totals bucket to medium.
